name: Westcliff Plaza
summary: Westcliff Plaza is a convenient neighborhood shopping center in Newport Beach offering everyday essentials and services along trendy 17th Street. Anchored by Ralphs and featuring fitness, banking, dining, and specialty retail options, this pedestrian-friendly plaza serves the surrounding affluent residential community with modern amenities.
demographics: Westcliff Plaza attracts an affluent, health-conscious demographic from the surrounding Newport Beach neighborhoods, with visitors typically in the 30-55 age range and household incomes exceeding $150,000. The trade area draws young professionals, established families, and active retirees who value convenience and quality in their daily shopping routines. Primary shoppers are time-pressed individuals seeking efficient access to everyday essentials, fitness activities, and casual dining options within a walkable, upscale environment.
description: Westcliff Plaza is a pedestrian-friendly neighborhood shopping center strategically positioned at the intersection of Westcliff Drive and Irvine Avenue in Newport Beach, California, along the trendy 17th Street corridor. This convenient open-air center serves as a daily destination for the surrounding affluent residential community, offering a carefully curated mix of essential services, fitness options, and dining experiences. Anchored by Ralphs grocery store, the plaza features a diverse tenant lineup including Orangetheory Fitness for health-conscious residents, The UPS Store for shipping needs, and popular dining destinations like O.E.B. Kitchen and The Chicken Shop for casual meals. The center also provides important financial services through Bank of America and Chase Bank branches, along with specialty retail like My Sister's Closet & Well Suited for luxury consignment shopping. With modern amenities including complimentary WiFi, bicycle parking, curbside pickup options, and full wheelchair accessibility, Westcliff Plaza exemplifies the contemporary neighborhood shopping experience that Newport Beach residents expect from their local retail destinations.
